claim: LLM accuracy on multiple-choice questions is higher when the language of the question matches the original language of the dataset, indicating reliance on language familiarity or memorization.
falsifier: Test LLMs on translated versions of multiple-choice datasets and compare accuracy to the original language version.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported LLMs, datasets, and languages; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Language match between question–Accuracy on original questions principle

claim: Integrating retrieval rails and content filtering into a guardrails framework reduces hallucination rates and improves response quality in healthcare AI systems.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by implementing a comparable guardrails framework with retrieval rails and content filtering, measuring hallucination rates and accuracy on a medical QA dataset before and after deployment.

conditions: applied to a language model (L2M3) in a healthcare context
guardrails include retrieval from trusted medical databases and content filtering rails
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system (L2M3 with NeMo Guardrails and Llama Guard), task (medical question answering), dataset (Med-HALT), and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Guardrails with retrieval rails for reduction in hallucination rates

claim: Different agentic architectures (e.g., triage-ranking, single agent) perform differently across chemical domains, with triage-ranking excelling for Cu(100) targets while other designs perform comparably or better for M–N–C catalysts.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing the performance of different agentic architectures on new materials discovery tasks across multiple domains.

conditions: CO adsorption on Cu(100) surface adatoms
CO adsorption on M–N–C single-atom catalysts
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific architectures compared and the two chemical domains; transfer to other architectures or domains is unestablished.

title: Agentic architecture type–Performance in identifying target principle
